_comment: Hearthbound: BWG biomes for WilderNature's spawns_minisheep. WilderNature's bison/boar/deer/owl/hedgehog/turkey/cassowary tags resolve through #minecraft:is_forest and #minecraft:is_savanna, which BWG joins, so those need no patch. Only the tags WilderNature pins to literal vanilla biomes (plains, beach, peaks) are here.
